fact: In April 2025 the decentralisation and land-planning ministry said the land information system (SIF) would be rolled out progressively in five pilot regions, Menabe, Atsimo Atsinanana, Anosy, Atsimo Andrefana and Analamanga, under the second national land programme.
title: MDAT: déploiement progressif du Système d'information foncière
